description: This file handles image processing for chat attachments within an Android app, including loading, decoding, scaling, and encoding images as Base64 strings with size limits and caching.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image from a URI, scales it within size constraints, compresses it to fit size limit, and encodes it into Base64, returning a PendingImageAttachment object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into a Bitmap, utilizing caching and resizing based on maximum dimensions.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an appropriate inSampleSize for BitmapFactory to decode large images efficiently within a max dimension.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and ensures a filename for image attachments, defaulting to 'image.jpg' if input is empty.
